_comment: Regions the shell paints on the device that a scene render has no reason to contain.
Every rect is in PANEL coordinates (368 x 448), keyed by the quarter turn the shell
was drawn at, and is deliberately larger than the thing it covers: a mask may only
ever hide more than it must. They are DECLARED here, not measured off an image - if
the chrome moves, this file is what has to move with it.
Provenance: main.c's HOME_HINT_WIDTH/HEIGHT/MARGIN and its BUILD_MARK_* constants,
both resolved through ui_anchor_rect() against the 368 x 448 panel.
The build mark's width follows the length of the short build id, which differs per
build; the rects below hold a mark of up to twelve glyphs.

home_hint.covers: main.c draw_home_hint() - the swipe-home strip, drawn for an app that opted into the gesture. The edge it sits on follows the swipe, so all four are masked.

build_mark.covers: main.c draw_build_mark() - the short build id in the corner of a development image. Release builds never draw it.
